info.description: Enterprise-grade WhatsApp Business API gateway with multi-user support, webhooks, RabbitMQ integration, and S3 storage
info.title: ZuckZapGo WhatsApp API Gateway

get.description: Retrieve all archived events including both DLQ (failed after max retries) and successfully delivered events. Supports filtering by status, transport, user, event type, and date range with pagination. Admin authentication required.

parameters.name: limit

post.description: Re-enqueue one or more archived events (DLQ or Success) back into the processing pipeline for retry. Supports single event replay by ID or bulk replay with filtering. Use dry_run to preview affected events without replaying. Admin authentication required.

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive statistics about the Event Archive including total count, success/DLQ breakdown, oldest/newest events by status, and distributions by transport and event type. Useful for monitoring system health and archive trends. Admin authentication required.
Retrieve detailed information about a specific archived event (DLQ or Success) by ID. Includes full event payload, status, timestamps, and replay history. Admin authentication required.

If a user ID is provided in the URL path, returns only that specific user's information. Admin authentication required.

post.description: When networkRoute is present, AddUser returns 2xx only with data.id, data.token and a ready data.network_route whose desired/applied versions match. If the user is persisted but route preparation fails, 503 returns data.userId without token so Chatwoot can DELETE /admin/users/{id}.
post.summary: Create a new ZuckZapGo user account with optional native mobile-route provisioning

get.description: Retrieve a list of all ZuckZapGo users with their complete configuration including connection status, webhook settings, proxy configuration, S3 storage, RabbitMQ messaging, and event filtering preferences. If a user ID is provided in the URL path, returns only that specific user's information. Admin authentication required.

parameters.description: Optional booleans: skipMedia, skipGroups, skipNewsletters, skipBroadcasts, skipOwnMessages, echoApiMessages, skipCalls

delete.description: Remove a ZuckZapGo user account and all associated data including WhatsApp session, webhook configurations, S3 settings, RabbitMQ configurations, and event filtering preferences. This operation is irreversible and will disconnect any active WhatsApp sessions. Admin authentication required.

Perform a complete deletion of a ZuckZapGo user account including all data, WhatsApp session files, database records, webhook configurations, S3 settings, RabbitMQ configurations, and any associated media files. This is a destructive operation that removes all traces of the user from the system. Admin authentication required.

post.description:
Creates a product in the own catalog of the connected session and returns it with its id.
price and sale_price are strings holding an integer in thousandths of the currency ("3000000" = R$ 3.000,00); currency (ISO-4217) is required with price and sale_price requires price.
image_urls (1-10, first is the main photo) must be HTTPS WhatsApp/Meta media URLs, normally the image_id returned by POST /business/products/image; other hosts are rejected by the WhatsApp library with 502 business operation failed (only the name, width/height and image count are validated with 400).
Country of origin is OPTIONAL in the API: send compliance_info.country_code_origin (ISO-3166 alpha-2) with optional importer_name/importer_address, or compliance_category COUNTRY_ORIGIN_EXEMPT without compliance_info when it does not apply. The official WhatsApp Web requires the choice for accounts with smb_product_country_of_origin_m1; omitting it is accepted by the server.
is_hidden=true creates the product already hidden. Products go through Meta review (status_info.status NO_REVIEW, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED); hidden or unreviewed products are not exposed by public catalog reads (GraphQL 2498052).

Uploads one JPEG or PNG photo (image field in base64, up to 16 MiB) and returns data.image_id, the HTTPS media URL to use in image_urls of POST /business/products or PUT /business/products/{productID}. Send one call per photo and do not retry automatically after an uncertain failure (5xx): the upload may have been accepted.

put.description:
Edits a product of the own catalog. The PUT replaces product_info entirely: every omitted field is removed (for example, editing without sale_price removes the sale price and without compliance_info removes the country of origin). Read the product first with GET /business/catalog/own and send it complete.
price and sale_price are strings holding an integer in thousandths of the currency ("3000000" = R$ 3.000,00); currency (ISO-4217) is required with price and sale_price requires price.
image_urls (1-10, first is the main photo) must be HTTPS WhatsApp/Meta media URLs, normally the image_id returned by POST /business/products/image; other hosts are rejected by the WhatsApp library with 502 business operation failed (only the name, width/height and image count are validated with 400).
Country of origin is OPTIONAL in the API: send compliance_info.country_code_origin (ISO-3166 alpha-2) with optional importer_name/importer_address, or compliance_category COUNTRY_ORIGIN_EXEMPT without compliance_info when it does not apply. The official WhatsApp Web requires the choice for accounts with smb_product_country_of_origin_m1; omitting it is accepted by the server.
Products go through Meta review (status_info.status NO_REVIEW, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED); hidden or unreviewed products are not exposed by public catalog reads (GraphQL 2498052). On read the server normalizes url with a trailing slash.

post.description: Resolve a business message link to get business information.

get.description: Fetch the full metadata for a public WhatsApp sticker pack by its pack ID. Returns the pack header (id/name/publisher/description/file-size/image-data-hash/tray image refs) plus the list of stickers (URL, direct-path, media key, file hashes, dimensions, MIME, emojis, accessibility label, handle). The response contains everything needed to download each sticker individually through /chat/downloadsticker — no extra round trips are required.

parameters.description: Sticker pack ID (32-char hex string published by WhatsApp)
parameters.name: packId

post.description: Send an accept stanza for an inbound call.
Answer a ringing inbound call (manual mode). Returns 404 if the call is not found.

get.description: Return the per-instance native calls engine configuration. callProviderToken is never returned.
get.summary: Get the native calls engine configuration

put.description: Persist the native calls engine configuration. callRecord applies to the live engine immediately (the next answered call records or not; a running recording is not cut); every other field applies on the next reconnect. Empty callInboundMode defaults to webhook; invalid mode returns 400. callProviderToken is write-only: when omitted or null the stored token is kept; send an empty string to clear it.
put.summary: Update the native calls engine configuration

post.description: Originate an outbound native call. phone accepts E.164 digits (no +), a phone JID, or a @lid — anything carrying an explicit @ is used as given. A plain number is resolved to the callee's LID first, which is what makes a Brazilian mobile typed WITH the ninth digit work even though WhatsApp stores many of them without it. Set video to place a video call (H.264). Returns 502 if the peer is unreachable.

parameters.description: phone (string: number, phone JID or @lid) and optional video (bool)
parameters.name: data

post.description: Places an outbound group call to two or more targets. Each target may be a phone number, a phone JID or a @lid. WhatsApp rejects a group call with fewer than two remote participants. Pass groupJid to keep the call BOUND to a WhatsApp group while calling only some of its members — the only way to call a group larger than WhatsApp's connected-limit (32 including you), since /call/group/dial-by-id refuses those outright.

parameters.description: targets (string array, min 2), optional video (bool), optional groupJid (string) to bind the call to a group
parameters.name: data

post.description: Resolves an existing WhatsApp group's roster and calls every remote member. The call stays bound to the group.
post.summary: Place a group call by group JID

post.description: End a live call and tear down its media session. Returns 404 if the call is not found.

Legacy route. Returns 501 make_call_not_implemented by default; place outbound calls with POST /call/dial. When the instance sets GLOBAL_CALL_INITIATE_DIAL_ALIAS=true this route becomes an alias of /call/dial (phone and optional video; returns callId; requires calls_enabled and a connected session).

parameters.description: Only used when GLOBAL_CALL_INITIATE_DIAL_ALIAS=true: phone (string: number, phone JID or @lid) and optional video (bool)
parameters.name: data

post.description: Creates a reusable public call link. Anyone with the token or URL can join, subject to the waiting room.
Joins an active call-link session, or enters its waiting room when the link requires approval. The resulting call is tracked like any other.

get.description: Reads call-link metadata without joining. Accepts the bare token or a full call.whatsapp.com URL.

post.description: Invites one or more people to a live call. Returns the list of targets that failed, so a partial failure is visible instead of collapsing into one error.
Play an audio source (audioUrl or audioBase64; WAV/MP3/Ogg-Opus) to the peer. Audio is auto-detected and resampled to 16kHz mono.
post.summary: Play audio into a live call

post.description: Send a preaccept stanza for an inbound call.

Record the peer's audio to a WAV file (requires S3 configured). Mutually exclusive with the media stream per call. Requires callRecord enabled in PUT /call/config; otherwise returns 403 call_recording_disabled and nothing is recorded.

403.description: call_recording_disabled: callRecord is off for this instance

post.description: Finalize the recording, upload the WAV to object storage, and return its URL as mediaKey (empty when no recording was active). On upload failure returns 400; the recording stays pending and is completed in the background, announced by the CallRecordingReady webhook.
Reject an incoming call. Optionally send a follow-up text message.
Send a custom call rejection message to a WhatsApp user or group. This is NOT the same as /call/reject, which rejects the call itself — this one delivers a message alongside the rejection.
post.summary: Send a custom call rejection message

get.description: List the native calls engine's currently tracked calls for the instance.

post.description: Send a terminate stanza. Default reason is "hangup".
Starts or stops sending local video on a live call. Frames are still pushed through the /call/{call_id}/video/stream websocket.
Turns the waiting room on or off for a call link. Admin only.

get.description: Server-Sent Events for everything peers do during a call: reactions, hand raise, mute state, screen share, group roster changes, waiting-room requests and call phase. Reactions are transient and cannot be polled, which is why this is a stream. Auth via ?token={TOKEN}.
Returns the authoritative participant roster for a live group call.

Upgrade to a WebSocket bridging raw PCM. Server sends binary s16le 16kHz mono frames (960 samples/1920 bytes per 60ms) of the peer audio; client sends s16le frames played to the peer. Mutually exclusive with recording per call.
Server-Sent Events stream for peer video state changes. Events are JSON objects with active, upgrade, orientation and raw fields.

Per-call video statistics while the call is running: participants sending video, frames received/delivered/shed, backlog bytes, and outbound frame counters. Use it to tell whether video lag is server-side backpressure or client-side decoding.
get.summary: Live video telemetry for a call

get.description: Upgrade to a WebSocket bridging raw H.264 Annex-B access units. Server sends peer video as binary frames; client sends binary frames that are forwarded to the peer. Pass fmt=participant to receive per-participant framed frames plus JSON control events (required for group video). Auth via ?token={TOKEN}.

parameters.description: Inbound framing: 'participant' for per-participant demux (group video). Default is bare access units.
parameters.name: fmt

get.description: Returns the pending-approval roster for a call link.

post.description: Archive or unarchive a chat to hide it from the main chat list. Archived chats are moved to the "Archived" folder and will reappear in the main list when a new message is received. You can optionally specify the last message information for proper synchronization. Set archive to true to archive or false to unarchive.

Delete a message from a chat (revoke — "This message was deleted" for every participant). Deletes your own messages in any chat. In GROUPS, a group admin can also delete OTHER participants' messages by passing the optional Sender field (the original author's JID, e.g. "5521999999999@s.whatsapp.net" or "123456@lid") — mirroring WhatsApp's admin delete-for-everyone. There may be a time limit for deletion depending on WhatsApp's policies.

Delete a chat entirely from the chat list. This is different from clearing chat history - it removes the chat from your chat list completely. The chat will reappear if you receive a new message from this contact. Optionally provide the last message details for more precise deletion. The delete_media parameter controls whether associated media files are also deleted (defaults to true). People are addressed by LID when known (index and last message key), groups by their JID. last_system_message_timestamp (optional, Unix seconds) marks the last system notice to delete (for example disappearing-messages notices); it defaults to last_message_timestamp, or to now when neither is sent.

Download an audio file from a WhatsApp message and return it as base64 encoded data URL. You need to provide the media information from the received message including URL, media key, and file hashes. The audio is decrypted and returned as a data URL that can be directly used in HTML audio tags or saved to disk. Supports voice messages, audio files (MP3, M4A, OGG), and PTT (push-to-talk) messages.

Download a document from a WhatsApp message and return it as base64 encoded data URL. You need to provide the media information from the received message including URL, media key, and file hashes. The document is decrypted and returned as a data URL that can be directly used or saved to disk. Supports all document types including PDF, DOC, XLS, PPT, ZIP, etc.

Download an image from a WhatsApp message and return it as base64 encoded data URL. You need to provide the media information from the received message including URL, media key, and file hashes. The image is decrypted and returned as a data URL that can be directly used in HTML img tags or saved to disk.

Download a sticker from a WhatsApp message and return it as base64 encoded data URL. You need to provide the media information from the received message including URL, media key, and file hashes. The sticker is decrypted and returned as a data URL (usually WebP format) that can be used directly or converted to other formats. Animated stickers are also supported.

Download a video from a WhatsApp message and return it as base64 encoded data URL. You need to provide the media information from the received message including URL, media key, and file hashes. The video is decrypted and returned as a data URL that can be directly used in HTML video tags or saved to disk. Supports MP4, AVI, MOV, and other video formats.

Adds or removes one chat (contact or group) from the Favorites list of the official apps. WhatsApp syncs Favorites as ONE complete ordered list (favorites app state action), so the gateway must know the current list to change a single entry: it uses the list last observed from app state or sent through this API (see GET /chat/favorites). When the list is unknown the request fails with 409 instead of silently wiping the other favorites; set force=true with favorite=true to replace the whole list with only this chat, or use PUT /chat/favorites with the complete list. People are addressed by LID when known.
post.summary: Add or remove a chat from Favorites

get.description: Returns the Favorites list. With refresh=true the gateway runs a full sync of the regular_high app state collection and rebuilds the list from the decrypted snapshot; complete=true is only returned after such a successful sync. Without it the list is the one last observed from app state or sent through this API; known=false means none was seen yet, in which case favorites is empty and does NOT mean the phone has no favorites. The full sync does not emit favorites events to webhooks.

parameters.description: Run a full sync of the regular_high collection first
parameters.name: refresh

500.description: No session or not logged in

501.description: Bundled library cannot return the snapshot

put.description: Replaces the complete ordered Favorites list with the given chats. This mirrors the official sync action, which always carries the whole list: chats missing from the request are removed from Favorites. An empty list clears Favorites. People are addressed by LID when known.

post.description: Mark one or more messages as read in a specific chat. This removes the unread badge and sends read receipts to the sender (if enabled in privacy settings). You must provide the chat JID, message IDs to mark as read, and optionally the sender JID for group messages. The operation updates the chat's unread count and last read message.

Mute or unmute notifications for a specific chat. When muted, you won't receive notifications for new messages in that chat. You can mute for 8 hours, 1 week, or always (until manually unmuted). Set mute to true with a duration to mute, or false to unmute. If no duration is specified when muting, it defaults to "always".

Pin or unpin a chat to keep it at the top of the chat list. Pinned chats appear at the top of the chat list for easy access. You can have up to 3 pinned chats on WhatsApp. Set pin to true to pin the chat or false to unpin it.

Sends the official PinInChatMessage (PIN_FOR_ALL / UNPIN_FOR_ALL) that shows the pinned-message banner at the top of the conversation for every participant. duration_seconds accepts 86400 (24 hours), 604800 (7 days, default) or 2592000 (30 days) and is ignored when unpinning. from_me tells whether the target message was sent by this account; for someone else's message in a group, sender_jid is required. In groups WhatsApp may restrict pinning to admins depending on the group settings. People are addressed by LID when known so the embedded key matches the destination.
post.summary: Pin or unpin a message inside a chat

post.description: Set chat presence status to indicate typing, recording audio, or paused state. This shows the "typing..." or "recording audio..." indicator to the recipient. The presence automatically clears after a few seconds, so you may need to send it periodically during long operations.

Send a reaction emoji to a specific message. Use empty string or "remove" to remove a reaction. The reaction appears below the message for all participants. Common reactions include 👍, ❤️, 😂, 😮, 😢, 🙏. You must specify the message ID and whether it was sent by you (prefix with "me:") or received from others. Optionally pass "chat" with the exact chat JID as received in the webhook (e.g. an "@lid" address) to guarantee the reaction renders on iOS; when omitted the phone number is used.

Send a message that quotes a previous one. Text content only;
media replies should use /chat/send/{image,video,document,audio} with quoted_msg_id.

Retry processing of an incoming message that failed to process correctly, such as messages with "Unknown-sender" state. This endpoint searches for the message in recent cache and callback sources, then forces reprocessing by sending a retry receipt to the original sender. Particularly useful for recovering messages that were received but not properly decrypted or processed due to session issues, missing keys, or temporary connectivity problems. The system will attempt to decrypt and reprocess the message using current session state.

Send an audio message or voice note to a WhatsApp contact or group. Supports various audio formats including MP3, OGG, AAC, and M4A. Can be sent as regular audio or PTT (Push To Talk) voice note. Audio can be provided as base64 data URL or HTTP(S) URL. Features include view-once messages, captions, replies, forwarding, and ephemeral messages. Audio is automatically processed and uploaded to configured S3 storage if available.

Send a message with interactive buttons to a phone number or group. This endpoint supports multiple button types including quick replies, URL links, phone calls, copy actions, and payment integrations (PIX). The message can include media attachments (images, videos, documents) and supports all message enhancements like mentions, replies, and forwarding.
Send interactive message with up to 3 action buttons to a WhatsApp contact or group. Requires a non-empty title with a maximum of 60 characters; do not send whitespace-only titles because WhatsApp renders an empty header area. Supports reply buttons, URL buttons, phone buttons, and PIX payment buttons. Can include optional media attachment (image, video, or document), footers, and ephemeral messages.
Send a carousel message with multiple cards to a phone number or group. Each card can contain images, videos, documents, text, and buttons.

Send a contact card (vCard) to a WhatsApp contact or group. The vCard can include phone numbers, email addresses, organization details, and more. Supports vCard 3.0 format. The contact will be displayed as an interactive card that recipients can save to their address book. Features include replies, forwarding, and ephemeral messages.

Sends the native WhatsApp contact request: a body text plus the "Share contact" button, the same interactive the Cloud API sends with interactive.type=request_contact_info. When the contact taps the button, their own contact card arrives as a regular Message webhook (contactMessage with isSelfContact=true, vCard with TEL;waid= and X-WA-LID). The reply carries no reference to the request.

Rules: one-to-one chats only (digits, <digits>@s.whatsapp.net or <digits>@lid); groups, newsletters, broadcast and status return 400. body is required, 1 to 1024 characters after trimming, never truncated. Available on every plan.

Idempotency: send your own id ([A-Za-z0-9], up to 128) and reuse it on every retry. A retry of an id already sent returns the original result without sending again (State sent, or confirmed with ConfirmedAt once the recipient's delivery/read receipt for that id arrives). 409 contact_request_dispatch_unknown means the send may have left and is never repeated; 409 contact_request_id_conflict means the id was used with another recipient, body or quote. Retry ids are remembered for 30 days.

400.description: error: contact_request_invalid_json | contact_request_phone_required | contact_request_invalid_phone | contact_request_invalid_recipient | contact_request_body_required | contact_request_body_too_long | contact_request_invalid_id | contact_request_invalid_context_info | contact_request_recipient_not_on_whatsapp

post.description: Send a document or file attachment to a phone number or group. Supports various file types including PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ZIP, and more. The document can be sent as a base64 data URL or HTTP(S) URL. Supports captions, mentions, replies, forwarding, and ephemeral messages. Media is automatically processed and uploaded to configured S3 storage if available.

Send an edited message to a phone number or group. Edits the text of a text message, or the CAPTION of an image, video or document — the target's type is detected automatically from its message id, so the request body is the same in both cases (`phone`, `id`, `body`). `body` carries the new text or the new caption. Media captions can be edited on messages sent through this API and on messages sent from the operator's own phone. If the target id is unknown to this instance the edit is sent as a text edit, as before. Supports mentions, replies, forwarding, and various message enhancements.
post.summary: Send edited message (text or media caption)

post.description:

RSVP to a calendar event. The event is identified by the message id of its creation message. `response` is one of GOING, NOT_GOING, MAYBE or UNKNOWN. `with_guest` (boolean) is WhatsApp's "Going with guest" — the official app only offers this option and always sends a guest count of 1, rendered as "Going with guest". `extra_guest_count` is deprecated but still accepted: 0 means no guest and any value >= 1 is sent as 1, exactly like the app; `with_guest` wins when both are present. Guests only apply to GOING (other responses are sent without guest). The creator must allow extra guests on the event for the guest to be shown. To remove a previous answer send `response` UNKNOWN. The RSVP is encrypted with the event's message secret, so the event must have been sent or received by this session — an event created before this instance recorded event metadata cannot be answered and returns 409.

400.description: Missing fields, or an unknown response value

409.description: Event predates RSVP support — its creator info was never recorded

post.description:
Send a WhatsApp Flow (an interactive form) to a contact.

How to use:
1. Create your form in the WhatsApp Business app (Tools > Forms).
2. Get your `flow_id`: send that form once from the app to any chat. Since your number is connected here, that message is delivered to your configured webhook — open it and copy the `flow_id` (and the rest of `button_params_json`). Save it. You only do this once per form, then reuse the saved `flow_id`.
3. Send the form here with `name` set to `galaxy_message` and your saved `flow_id` inside `button_params_json`.
4. The answers your contact submits come back to your configured webhook.
post.summary: Send flow message (WhatsApp Flow / interactive form)

Send a poll with multiple choice options to a WhatsApp group or contact. Polls allow recipients to vote on options you provide. post.description: Send an audio status. audio accepts a base64 data URL or an HTTP(S) URL. ptt=true (default) sends a voice note: use OGG/Opus; the MIME is normalized to exactly "audio/ogg; codecs=opus" because the official apps silently drop voice-note statuses with any other MIME. ptt=false sends an audio file (MP3, M4A/AAC or OGG; unknown types fall back to audio/mpeg). audience restricts who sees the status to individual PN (digits or PN@s.whatsapp.net) or LID recipients and exclude_list removes recipients; entries that are not individual PN or LID recipients are ignored; requests without audience/exclude_list, or whose entries are all empty or invalid, use the account status privacy. A valid audience or exclude_list is never widened: if it cannot be applied (no recipients remain after exclusions, or recipient resolution fails) the status is not sent and the route returns 500 with the send failure error suffixed by "(status audience could not be applied; the status was not sent)". The audience never returns 400. The response reports the final mime_type, duration in seconds and has_waveform.
